output.summary: Adds a POST /orders feature across layers: a route registered in the app, a service that validates quantity, and an in-memory storage layer. A test covers the service. Check that the route handler's unvalidated body cast is acceptable.

groups.title: POST /orders endpoint
groups.description: registerRoutes wires a new postOrder handler, which casts the body and calls createOrder. Check that the body is validated somewhere, since the cast is unchecked.

groups.title: createOrder service
groups.description: createOrder rejects quantities below 1 and delegates to insertOrder. Confirm the validation rule is the intended one.

groups.title: In-memory order storage
groups.description: Adds the OrderRow type and insertOrder, which assigns ids from the array length. Check that id assignment and shared module state are acceptable.

groups.title: createOrder test
groups.description: Tests that the first created order gets id 1. Check whether the quantity validation failure is also meant to be covered.
